recentResults.issueTitle: actions: lightweight submission occupies the sole warm worker and repeatedly cold-starts background work
recentResults.reasoning: This is a confirmed performance bug in action-worker allocation: a lightweight parent action occupies the sole warm worker, forcing its detached child onto a repeatedly discarded cold worker. The detailed reproduction, timings, source analysis, and mitigation provide enough information to act without additional flags. It warrants normal-course priority because it causes recurring multi-second latency in affected workflows, but it does not break the system or risk data. No existing label clearly represents the action-worker or worker-pool component, so no area label applies.
